Source is browser-only: imports lucide-react AlertTriangle, web AlertBanner, and @/lib/browserCompat (detectMissingFeatures/dismissCompatWarning/isCompatWarningDismissed) which probe BroadcastChannel/ResizeObserver/Intl.RelativeTimeFormat/CSS :has()/structuredClone and persist to localStorage. None exist in React Native, so per contract rule 7 a native-safe implementation was created with an explicit unavailable state.

Native-safe detectMissingFeatures() returns [] because browser-platform feature detection is not applicable to a native runtime (the app owns its JS engine), faithfully reproducing the web banner's hidden state on supported environments while the testHookMissing seam still renders the warning UI for specs.

Dismissal persistence: localStorage has no native equivalent, so the versioned storage key was replaced with an in-process module flag (resets on app restart) -- the same documented fallback the web helper uses under Safari private-mode/quota; isCompatWarningDismissed()/dismissCompatWarning() names and semantics preserved.

Preserved state names (missing, dismissed), props (testHookMissing default {}), behavior (re-detect effect, handleDismiss, null guard, featureList join, body interpolation), i18n keys (compat.banner.title/body/dismiss) and English copy including the Chrome >=110 recommendation, via a native translation fallback that interpolates {{features}}/{{recommendation}}.
